name: Csólyospálos (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csólyospálos: a shield of yellow, blue and red with a hand, a church and clasped hands, with a helm, blue and red mantling and a scroll inscribed CSÓLYOSPÁLOS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csólyospálos arms with helm, mantling and scroll
